instruction.sound: Ravi has built a tower out of building blocks. But a few colours are still missing! Listen carefully. First, choose a colour and paint the block that is on top of the light blue block.
instruction.text: Colour in the building block on top of the light blue block.

instruction.sound: Great! Now paint the building block that is underneath the pink one.
instruction.text: Colour in the building block under the pink building block.

instruction.sound: Now paint the square block next to the light blue one.
instruction.text: Colour in the building block next to the light blue building block.

instruction.sound: Ravi has now built another tower. First, paint the building block under the yellow building block.
instruction.text: Colour in the building block under the yellow building block.

instruction.sound: Very good! Now paint the building block that is on top of the yellow one.
instruction.text: Colour in the building block on top of the yellow building block.

instruction.sound: And now paint the block on top of the blue one.
instruction.text: Colour in the building block on top of the blue building block.

instruction.sound: Lastly, paint the block next to the orange one.
instruction.text: Colour in the building block next to the orange building block.
